hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *databricks.yml|*/resources/*.yml|*/resources/*.yaml) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && databricks bundle validate --profile free-edition 2>&1) ;; esac; }

git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'BEGIN (RSA|OPENSSH|EC) PRIVATE KEY|DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET *=|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|dapi[0-9a-f]{32}' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Secret-shaped content detected in staged diff (private key / AKIA / ghp_ / dapi token pattern). Review before committing."}}' || exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Scanning staged diff for secret-shaped content...
